groups.coverage: 8 existing DDP and 5 new four-model integration tests

coverage: Unequal-size cases and different owner counts
Global gradients/Adam agree with original dense node-weighted objective
Short final batch uses each real sample once
Same-world CPU resume preserves parameters, Adam and history exactly
All four old optimized single/model-parallel checkpoints import

small_gpu_two_agents.scope: Two torchrun agents on two physical RTX3090 GPUs on ONE host; small unequal-size cases, not X203 inter-node or full-domain throughput evidence

real_geo_capacity.scope: Capacity probe: BOTH ranks replicate the same real full faNN case with single-case normalization; not formal distinct-case DDP training, accuracy, X203 or inter-node throughput evidence

limitations: No physical X203 multi-node run was possible locally
All four distinct-case DDP integration tests use small fixtures
Real full-case capacity test replicated the same geometry on two GPUs; it is not a multi-geometry accuracy benchmark
Heavy-model rank count requires node CPU RAM sizing; memory was moved to CPU, not eliminated
One rank still needs a complete-case optimized execution path; this is not intra-case cross-node partitioning
